scope: exploratory pilot on identical 900 source rows per model
primary_metrics: deterministic POPE scoring against source labels
reviewer: GPT-6 for supplemental visual review only; not a GPT benchmark judge
limitations: Same source rows, but prompts, processor preprocessing and generation limits differ.
Smol source CSV omits image_source, so linkage uses id/question/category/label, not inference-time image hashes.
LBL and U are unresolved after visual inspection; neither is forced into a definite hallucination label.
No review of all full-9000 errors; full outputs only contribute an auxiliary quantitative table.
Phi detection/improvement packet concerns a different 900-row selection and is not combined with the latest inference.
